findings.claim: The change removes the Str8 case from the string-header writer in MessagePackPrimitives.Writers.cs. Strings of 32-255 bytes will now be written with a Str16 header (3 bytes) instead of Str8 (2 bytes). This changes the serialized bytes and the canonical MessagePack encoding. It is unrelated to the requirement about the analyzer with SuppressSourceGeneration=true, and the requirement says only analyzer behaviour should change. Non-compact output also affects wire compatibility and size.
